messages:
maria: Heads up — planning RBAC lock for private deploys. Want to restrict the 'sre' role from accessing customer-keystore endpoints. Any blockers for rollout? /cc @jamal @alex
jamal: +1 on restricting, but key-sync job currently uses the SRE token, need migrate to a scoped service account first
alex: We can create a key-sync SA with kms:Decrypt only. Posting example key policy and minimal perms in a sec snippet
alex: ```json
{
  "Version":"2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Action": ["kms:Decrypt", "kms:Encrypt"],
      "Resource": "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/rdw-private-*",
      "Condition": {
        "StringEquals": {
          "kms:CallerAccount": "123456789012"
        }
      }
    }
  ]
}
```
maria: thx. For network isolation — thinking NetPol to block egress from model-runner pods except to KMS endpoints, internal registry, DNS, NTP and prometheus. Sample below:
maria: ```yaml
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: deny-egress-except-kms
spec:
  podSelector:
    matchLabels:
      app: model-runner
  policyTypes: ["Egress"]
  egress:
  - to:
    - ipBlock:
        cidr: 10.0.0.0/16
    - namespaceSelector:
        matchLabels:
          name: infra
    ports:
    - protocol: TCP
      port: 443
```
emily: Make sure we allow metrics exporter to prometheus and the health check probes
jamal: also add DNS (53/UDP) and NTP to the allowed egress list
vuln-bot: CVE-2026-0420 flagged in dependency 'fastcrypto' — medium severity, possible issue in crypto binding layer on certain binaries; flagged for onprem compute images
sre-ops-bot: Created incident INC-20260301-09 and assigned to jamal, maria
jamal: quick triage: reproducer touches TPM path, but exploit requires code execution. Low blast unless combined with container escape. Proposed mitigations: patch fastcrypto, rotate keys, enable KMS decrypt audit logs for last 30d, rebuild hardened images
maria: steps & timeline?
jamal: plan:
1) create scoped service account for key-sync; remove SRE privileges
2) update RBAC and test in staging canary
3) patch fastcrypto version and rebuild images
4) rotate KMS keys via alias swap (keep old alias pinned for 1h rollback)
5) enable and retain KMS decrypt audit logs 90d; push to secure bucket
6) run canary 10% traffic then promote if clean
alex: For audit logs, we'll use fluent-bit redact filter and route to a secure S3 bucket encrypted with a dedicated key. CLI for retention:
alex: ```bash
aws logs put-retention-policy --log-group-name /redwood/private/kms-decrypt --retention-in-days 90
```
emily: QA will run canary and validate metrics + tail logs. Need explicit rollback trigger (error rate > 0.5% or auth failures)
maria: also please add an 'x-audit-id' header on internal KMS proxied calls so we can correlate in logs during incident investigations
alex: will add header and index it in CloudWatch logs as a field
sec-team: will review the KMS key policy and netpol snippets, ETA ~6h for formal review :eyes:
jamal: drafting the runbook now, including exact kubectl/netpol commands, key-rotation play, and smoke-tests
devex-bot: Draft runbook published https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/SEC/Private+KMS+RBAC+Rollout
maria: thanks. merging RBAC change to canary tomorrow 02:00 UTC. If no alerts in +4h we promote. Jamal and Alex will be on-call for the window
jamal: on-call for rollout :+1:
maria: closing loop — will post a short postmortem if anything odd. Thanks everyone.
